_readme: Curated country-name aliases unioned into core-geo entities on top of the ones Wikidata's altLabels supply (ticket #183). Author-supplied, because these are the short/common/official forms Wikidata omits OR that the answer normalizer can't reach: it keeps a leading 'the' and turns 'U. S. A.' into 'u s a' (spaced), so bare 'USA'/'US'/'UK' are not accepted from the existing altLabels alone. Applied by apply-alias-overrides.mjs (label-preserving) and re-applied on a full fetch-entities.mjs run. Additive and idempotent: an alias already accepted is a harmless no-op. Keyed by Wikidata Q-id; `country` is a comment for reviewers.
